title: New films, support and international recognition
description: The period saw the creation of the Serasary production-support fund and the release or international circulation of films including Djaomalaza, Malagasy Mankany, Madame Esther, Ady Gasy, Anay ny lalana and Benja Kely. Together they show renewed production across fiction, documentary and short film, and growing participation in African and international festivals.
